events.event: Tokopedia, Shopee, Lazada and Blibli are due to start withholding 0.5% PPh Pasal 22 on online sellers' gross turnover from 1 November 2026, after the DJP postponement that runs to 31 October.
events.key_numbers: 0.5% of gross turnover (excl. PPN/PPnBM) · starts 1 Nov 2026 · postponement ran to 31 Oct 2026 · individual sellers up to Rp500 juta/year not withheld but must file a turnover statement · turnover counted across all platforms and offline · basis PMK 37/2025 · first set for 1 Jul 2026
events.why_it_matters: Millions of online sellers above Rp500 juta turnover will see tax deducted automatically from sales, and many believe it is a new tax.

events.event: Apple iPhone Duo preorders in Indonesia opened 23 Oct at 09.00 WIB and sold out at several official distributor sites by 11.00 WIB; official sales are scheduled from 30 October.
events.key_numbers: 256 GB Rp45.678.910 · 512 GB Rp51.999.000 · 1 TB Rp61.999.000 · 2 TB Rp75.999.000 · preorder sold out by 11.00 WIB 23 Oct · sales from 30 Oct 2026 · channels iBox, Digimap, Erajaya
events.why_it_matters: A phone priced up to Rp76 juta sold out in two hours, which says a lot about who is still spending.
events.spreading_evidence: Covered same day by CNBC Indonesia, CNN Indonesia, Katadata, detik, Suara

events.event: The Pengadilan Niaga at PN Jakarta Pusat annulled the KPPU decision that found 97 P2P lending (pinjol) platforms guilty of price-fixing interest rates, saying the ceiling was OJK policy, not a cartel.
events.key_numbers: 97 pinjol platforms · KPPU fine reported as Rp755 miliar (per Kontan/Monitor Indonesia headlines, not in CNBC text) · ruling read 22 Oct 2026 · KPPU ordered to pay court costs Rp23.592.000 · ceiling per AFPI guidelines 2018/2020/2021 and SEOJK 19/SEOJK.06/2023 effective 1 Jan 2024
events.why_it_matters: Borrowers' loan interest stays under OJK's ceiling regime rather than a competition ruling, and KPPU may still appeal to the Supreme Court.

events.event: Komdigi's Digital Infrastructure DG Wayan Toni Supriyanto says Kupang and Bitung are candidate new data-centre hubs outside Java and Batam, and draft Perpres on data centres and undersea cables are in public consultation.
events.key_numbers: Kupang and Bitung named · draft Perpres data centre and undersea cable in public consultation · no issuance date · horizon 2030 for AI support · Komdigi says 580 MW is not enough for AI sovereignty (per Feedberry headline)
events.why_it_matters: Where AI data centres go decides where jobs, power and water demand land, and CNBC also frames them as competing with farmers for water.

events.event: Under Ministerial Regulation 3/2026 (Kepmen UMKM 398/2026), e-commerce platforms must cut admin fees by at least 50% for verified micro and small sellers of domestic products from 25 Oct; still unreported whether the first sellers received it.
events.key_numbers: At least 50% fee cut · starts 25 Oct 2026 · verification up to 10 days · payout within 5 days
events.why_it_matters: Pair with the 1 Nov marketplace tax: sellers get a fee cut and a tax withholding in the same week.

events.event: Apple is expected to hold an event on 28 Oct 2026 where a touchscreen MacBook Pro is widely rumoured; same day Huawei starts China sales of the Pura 90 Plus (preorders open).
events.key_numbers: Apple event 28 Oct 2026 (rumour of touchscreen MacBook Pro, per Kompas/detik headlines) · Huawei Pura 90 Plus China sales 28 Oct, up to 12 GB RAM and 1 TB, price not stated, China only
events.why_it_matters: Gadget news ahead, but nothing is Indonesia-specific yet.
